name: Ricardo Garcia
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in his father's auto body shop in Valencia. He spent his youth mastering the art of flawless paint application and intricate detailing. This foundational skill led him to specialize in custom finishes and restorations. After working on classic cars for years, Ricardo yearned for the high-stakes environment of racing. He joined Manthey EMA a decade ago, bringing his meticulous eye and steady hand to the team's livery designs and repairs. 

Ricardo is known for his dedication to achieving perfection. He approaches every task with a methodical precision, ensuring each layer of paint is flawlessly applied and perfectly cured. His experience allows him to identify and resolve potential paint issues before they arise, saving the team valuable time and resources. A loyal team member, Ricardo is always willing to share his knowledge and mentor younger colleagues.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a focused expression and perpetually paint-flecked hands.

quirks: Always wears a pristine white lab coat, despite the inevitable paint splatters.
Insists on listening to flamenco music while working, claiming it enhances his focus.
Has a collection of vintage paint color swatches that he refers to for inspiration.
